title: Layoffs, Hospital Care, and City Finances
summary:
*   **Budget Focus:** The meeting was a worksession dedicated to the city's 1988-89 operating budget, including a review of projected property and sales tax revenues.
*   **Proposed Layoffs:** A significant report detailed a proposal for the layoff of 271 city employees.
*   **Hospital Funding:** Discussions addressed information concerning uncompensated care at Brackenridge Hospital, a key public health issue.
*   **Infrastructure Costs:** Councilmembers reviewed specific financial items, including cost figures for a "south sub-station" and a request for a legal opinion on renegotiating its lease.

Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Council Chambers. 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas 9:00 Α.Π.
August 03, 1988-
Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council at 1:30 P.M., noting
the presence of all Councilmembers. Mayor Cooke stated the purpose of the meeting was a
worksession on the Operating Budget for 1988-89.
Sarah Farley, Budget Director, and Susan Tully presented the revenue analysis. They
reviewed projected property tax and sales tax revenues.
Joe Canales presented a report on proposed lay-off of 271 employees.
John Ware, Acting City Manager, presented the uncompensated care information concerning
Brackenridge Hospital.
Mayor Cooke then announced Council would begin hearing the budget statement from each City
department. Building Safety: Mike Heits and Kathy Rodgers explained the budget for the
Building Safety Department.
Mayor Pro Ten Shipman requested cost figures for the south sub-station and asked for a
legal opinion concerning re-negotiation of the lease.
RECESS
-
Council recessed its meeting from 3:22 p.m. to 4:30 p.. to continue the other meeting
scheduled for 9:00a.m. this date.
MEETING RESUMED AND THEN ADJOURNED
The meeting was resumed at 4:30p.m. with more of the budget worksession. Council adjourned
its meeting at 5:00 p.m.
